text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I went shopping in town
with Copano Rickey, but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!?
A birdie's dropping... landed on my shoe!?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, not really!
If you wipe it down properly and clean it, there won't be any problem!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Besides, people say things like this bring good luck, so you can think of it as a fortune boost! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Everything is all about perspective!
Seeing things positively and maintaining a sense of gratitude is, in Feng Shui, above all else—

text_block_list.name: Florist Staff
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaah, I'm so sorry!!
I wasn't looking and sprayed water all over you...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey ended up getting completely drenched in water.
Although she managed to dry her wet clothes...
choice_data_list: That was one misfortune after another...
That was one misfortune after another...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Come on, like I just said,
it's all about how you look at it!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Getting splashed washed the dirt off my shoes too,
so keep feeling grateful and happy!
Staying positive is the basic rule for attracting good luck♪

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We're running a special campaign today~!
Order our limited-time Hachimi, and get a voucher for a free regular-size Hachimi!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Waah, they're having a special campaign!
Aren't we super lucky?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Looking forward really is the best way to invite good luck!
Excuse me, one limited-edition Hachimi, please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her positive attitude, backed by feng shui, seemed to invite a bit of good luck. After sharing some Hachimi together, we were both filled with happiness.
